entities.summary: Nitza Margarita Cintrón is a Puerto Rican scientist and former Chief of Space Medicine and Health Care Systems Office at NASA's Johnson Space Center. She currently works at the University of Texas in the Galveston Medical Branch as faculty in the Department of Internal Medicine.
